segments.sn24.4:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.4:1.3: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’”ti?
segments.sn24.4:2.1: “Rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.4:2.2: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’ti.
segments.sn24.4:2.3: Vedanāya sati … saññāya sati … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.4:2.7: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’”ti.
segments.sn24.4:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.4:3.3: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.4:3.5: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’ti?
segments.sn24.4:3.7: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.4:3.11: “Aniccaṃ, bhante … pe … api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.4:3.13: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’”ti?
segments.sn24.4:3.15: “Yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.4:3.16: “Aniccaṃ, bhante … pe … api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.4:3.18: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī”ti?
segments.sn24.4:4.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imesu ca ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti … pe … dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyapissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.
